name: Kaneko Ryuuji
source:
A senior of both the protagonist and Sayaka from their university days.

During their time in the university drama club, he served as its president, writing the scripts himself and taking the leading roles in its productions.

He already had a reputation for being woman-hungry back then, and rumors circulated that he had been involved with practically every woman in the club.

His family belongs to the wealthy business-owning family that runs a major chain of wedding venues. Having grown up without ever wanting for anything, he has come to believe that practically everything in the world can be made to go his way.

After graduating, he joined his father's company. Of his own choosing, he works on-site as a wedding venue staff member.

He has considerable experience and an excellent track record as a wedding planner, and enjoys the trust of his fellow employees.

However, behind the scenes, he has taken advantage of the emotional vulnerability of numerous brides-to-be in the period leading up to their weddings, exploiting them for his own gratification.

He doesn't particularly think of himself as stealing women away from their husbands-to-be. His reasoning is simply that "women who are about to get married are more likely to put out," which is why he targets them.

After graduating from university, he had gradually lost contact with the protagonist and Sayaka.

However, the three unexpectedly reunite when he encounters them while working at a bridal fair held at the wedding venue where he is employed.

From then on, he becomes their wedding coordinator.

Whenever the protagonist is occupied with work and Sayaka comes to the venue alone for consultations, he gradually begins extending his predatory influence over her...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
